'''UPL Limited''', formerly '''United Phosphorus Limited''', is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational company]] that manufactures and markets [[Agrochemical|agrochemicals]], industrial chemicals, chemical intermediates, and [[specialty chemicals]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Company Overview of UPL Limited |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=20376936 |website=Bloomberg| date=20 May 2023 }}</ref> Headquartered in [[Mumbai]], the company is primarily engaged in the manufacture and marketing of conventional agrochemicals, seeds, and other agriculture-related products. It also manufactures fungicides, herbicides, insecticides, plant growth regulators, rodenticides, industrial and specialty chemicals, and nutrifeeds.<ref>{{cite web |title=Company Profile for UPL Limited |url=https://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/company-profile/UPLL.NS |website=Reuters |access-date=16 March 2019 |language=en}}{{dead link|date=September 2024|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref><ref name = "Forbes">{{cite web |title=UPL Limited on the Forbes Asia's Fab 50 Companies List |url=https://www.forbes.com/companies/upl-limited/#324126e55da2 |website=Forbes |access-date=16 March 2019 |language=en}}</ref>

United Phosphorus Limited was established on 29 May 1969.<ref name = "Forbes"/> The company changed its name to UPL Limited in October 2013.<ref>{{cite web |title=UPL LTD – GDR (UPL:Singapore): Company Description – Bloomberg |url=http://www.investing.businessweek.wallst.com/research/stocks/snapshot/snapshot_article.asp?ticker=UPL:SP |website=Bloomberg |access-date=16 March 2019 }}{{Dead link|date=January 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

On 20 July 2018, UPL signed a US$4.2 billion agreement with Platform Specialty Products Corporation (now [[Element Solutions|Element Solutions Inc.]]) to acquire control of Arysta LifeScience Inc. The acquisition was completed in February 2019,<ref>{{cite web |title=UPL completes acquisition of Arysta LifeScience for $4.2 billion |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/upl-completes-acquisition-of-arysta-lifescience-for-4-2-billion/articleshow/67836964.cms |website=The Economic Times |access-date=16 March 2019 |date=4 February 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=UPL Jumps The Most In Four Years After $4.2 Billion Deal To Acquire Arysta Lifescience |url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/upl-jumps-the-most-in-two-years-after-42-billion-deal-to-acquire-arysta-lifescience#gs.194zrt |website=BloombergQuint |date=23 July 2018 |access-date=16 March 2019 }}{{Dead link|date=January 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref> making UPL the fifth largest generic agrochemicals company in the world after [[Bayer]], [[Corteva]], [[Syngenta]] and [[BASF]].<ref>{{cite web |title=All You Need To Know About UPL's Latest Buyout Plan |url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/all-you-need-to-know-about-upls-latest-buyout-plan#gs.194z73 |website=BloombergQuint |date=17 July 2018 |access-date=16 March 2019 }}{{Dead link|date=January 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=UPL Completes Acquisition of Arysta LifeScience |url=https://www.agriculture.com/news/business/upl-completes-acquisition-of-arysta-lifescience |website=Successful Farming |access-date=16 March 2019 |language=en |date=1 February 2019}}</ref>

UPL Limited, formerly United Phosphorus Limited, is an Indian multinational company that manufactures and markets agrochemicals, industrial chemicals, chemical intermediates, and specialty chemicals. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company is primarily engaged in the manufacture and marketing of conventional agrochemicals, seeds, and other agriculture-related products. It also manufactures fungicides, herbicides, insecticides, plant growth regulators, rodenticides, industrial and specialty chemicals, and nutrifeeds.
United Phosphorus Limited was established on 29 May 1969. The company changed its name to UPL Limited in October 2013.
On 20 July 2018, UPL signed a US$4.2 billion agreement with Platform Specialty Products Corporation (now Element Solutions Inc.) to acquire control of Arysta LifeScience Inc. The acquisition was completed in February 2019, making UPL the fifth largest generic agrochemicals company in the world after Bayer, Corteva, Syngenta and BASF.
